always: One single hero object (or one tight cluster) sits in the middle of the square card and fills roughly 70-90% of its width or height.

The hero is a saturated, warm or primary-colored 3D toy-like render (blue, red, yellow, orange) set against a contrasting background hue: blue on orange or pink, yellow on purple, red on green or blue, red on purple-pink.
The hero is the first read at thumbnail size, and its silhouette names the object: ticket, neck pillow, fins, phone booth, swing ride, sneakers, book, gloves, palm, pump.
The hero is lit and has a soft contact shadow or sits on a base, so it stands apart from the background.
The background is simple and behind the hero: a flat color with radial rings, stripes or a swirl, or a plain backdrop with a floor plane.
varies: Margins range from tight to roomy. The pillow, boxing gloves, book and ticket come within about 5-10% of the edges. The sneakers, fins and swing ride leave about 10-15%. The sneakers have empty background above them.

Placement is either upright and centered (phone booth, swing ride, pump, planter) or tilted about 30-45 degrees (ticket, fins, book). The gloves are cropped at the left edge and the pillow is nearly cropped at the top.

Background complexity varies. Flat gradients (ticket, pillow, fins, carousel) are quiet. Scenic backgrounds (planter with fence, pump with desert, palm with sand) are busier. The tiki bar scene fills the card edge to edge, with no single hero.
Some hero shapes fill the card as a tall block (phone booth, pump), others as a wide shape (sneakers, fins, gloves, planter).
Some cards add small secondary props, such as the watering can and trowel, the fruit and cocktails, or the sand rocks. They sit inside the hero's footprint and the hero still wins.
never: A tiny hero lost in empty space. Even the smallest hero fills more than about half the card.
An off-center hero that pushes the card into a lopsided layout.
Text, UI frames or badges competing with the hero.
A dark or muddy background, or a hero in the same hue as its background.
Several equal-weight objects spread across the card. The exception is the tiki bar scene, where a dense scene replaces the single hero.
generator_wording: One large centered 3D toy-style object filling about 80% of the square card, with a small, even margin. Either upright or tilted about 35 degrees. Saturated primary colors, with the background in a contrasting hue. Simple backdrop: flat color with soft rings, or a plain floor. Soft contact shadow. No text, no clutter, no cropping.
